rationale: The assistant correctly identified from the outset that heat pump dryers run cooler and longer ('very likely not faulty'), sensibly ruled out filters and a low-heat programme, picked up on the cold garage, and explained how door-opening adds time, matching the hidden truth with no parts or escalation pushed. It never confirmed the key check that clothes come out dry at the end, did not mention washer spin speed, and offered no fallback (contact Bosch under warranty if the drum never warms), so the close was slightly more confident than the evidence it gathered. The 45-50°C explanation was repeated in every turn and the 'suitable replacement' model-number panel was incongruous, but neither blocked progress.
